senses.gloss:
Hurl,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓ(tarasA-savegaM) kzip 6 P, vi-sfj-muc 6 P, prAs 4 U, Ir c., prez c., prahf 1 P; ‘h(url) down’ ni ava-pat c., avaBraMS c., aDaH-kzip.
Ⓔs.ⒹkzepaH-paRaM, pAtanaM.
Ⓑ
 2 tumulaM, kolA-halaH.
Ⓝ[Hurl]ing,Ⓒs.ⒹkzepaRaM; ‘h(urling) of stones’ SilAvarzaH-AsAraH.
Hurricane,Ⓒs.ⒹprakaMpanaH, mahAvAtaH, ativAtaH, praBaMjanaH, vAtyA, pracaMqavAtaH, vegAnilaH, vAtAlI, vAtyAvegaH, cakravAtaH, javAnilaH, JaMJAvAtaH (with showers).

Hurry,Ⓒv. i.Ⓓtvar 1 A, SIGraM gam 1 P, sa-saMBramaM gam.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓtvar c. (tvarayati).
Ⓑ
 2 satvaraM Akfz 1 P or praRud 6 P, or prer c.; SIGraM saM-niH-pad c. or vi-DA 3 U or sAD 5 P.
Ⓔs.ⒹtvarA, saMBramaH, raBas n., raBasaH, vyagratA, vegaH, AkulatvaM, A-saM-vegaH, tvaritagati f.; ‘why are you in such a h(urry)’ kimasi [] saMBrAMteva (U. 3); ‘in a h(urry)’ saMBrAMta, vyA-kula, vyagra.
Ⓝ[Hurri]ed,Ⓒa.Ⓓtvarita, SIGra; ‘a h(urried) speech’ nirastaM vacaH, tvaritoditaM.
Ⓝ[Hurri]edly,Ⓒadv.ⒹSIGraM, tvaritaM, satvaraM, sasaMBramaM, saraBasaM, vyagraM.

Hurt,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓkzi 5 P, tud 6 P, hiMs 7 P, ard 1 P or c., bAD 1 A, vyaT c. (vyaTayati), druh 4 P, kzaR 8 P, pIq 10, apakf 8 U, vipra-kf, du 5 P; ‘does not h(urt) oneʼs reputation’ yaSaH na kziRoti (R. ii. 40).
Ⓔs.ⒹkzataM, hiMsA, apakAraH, apakfti f., bADA, pIqA, vyaTA.
Ⓑ
 2 apAyaH, kzayaH, hAni f., nASaH.
Ⓝ[Hurt]ful,Ⓒa.ⒹpIqAkara (rI f.), apAyAvaha, hiM-sAtmaka, bADaka, apakArin, ahita-hAni-kzati-kara.
Ⓑ
 2 hiMsra, GAtuka, SarAru.
Ⓝ[Hurt]fully,Ⓒadv.ⒹhiMsApUrvaM, sApakAraM.
Ⓝ[Hurt]less,Ⓒa.Ⓓakzata.
Ⓑ
 2 ahiMsra, anapakArin, anupadravin.

Hurtle,Ⓒv. i.ⒹsaMGawwa 1 A, aBisaM-pat 1 P.
Ⓑ
 2 saraBasaM nizkram 1 U, 4 P or nirgam 1 P.
Ⓑ
 3 Echo, q. v.
